code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colors = set(row)
        if len(colors) == 2:
            bg = max(colors, key=row.count)
            fg = next(c for c in colors if c != bg)
            if row.count(fg) < len(row):
                out[r] = [1 if v == bg else v for v in row]
    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) != 2 or len(set(row)) == 1:
            continue
        # Complete a partial horizontal bar by coloring its trailing background section.
        first = next((i for i, v in enumerate(row) if v != row[0]), None)
        if first is not None and all(v == row[0] for v in row[:first]):
            out[r][first:] = [1] * (len(row)-first)
    return out
'''
